correctness.rationale: The exact master equation specifies offdiagonal dephasing rate gamma and trap population loss kappa. A positive-density Hilbert--Schmidt dissipation identity and connectivity prove certain capture for gamma>0; an eight-coordinate symmetry reduction yields all integrated terms, including the same-part two-site boundary. Strict convexity proves optimum uniqueness; exact derivative scaling proves distinct root and excess limits. The independent unreduced density-matrix solver passed 106 comparisons/optimization tests. Risk: coherent gamma=0 is asserted only in the source sector proved free of accessible dark states.

value.rationale: The same two-sided dense quantum network has inequivalent noise-optimal transport according to the source partition, including a sharp size-two boundary where all dephasing worsens same-part mean capture. The entire family has explicit mean-time formulas and two different leading square-root dephasing strengths for a growing opposite partition. This is a natural transport-design invariant, not a numerical slice or a restated star-graph formula. Its scope is the physically specified loss-free, uniform dephasing model.
